Synopsis:
Short dialog if player tries to approach Viconia without Shadowheart nearby. Viconia seeks to acquire the Astral Prism (the artefact SH once guarded) but that is impossible. Instead, Viconia demands the player demand SH to her for punishment, or else she and her followers will attack.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_SharGrotto_ConfrontViconia_NoShadowheart.json: You approached Viconia while Shadowheart—the companion who once guarded the Astral Prism—is not present. Viconia wants the Astral Prism returned to her, but the artefact is now impossible to recover. With the prism unattainable, Viconia demands you hand Shadowheart over for punishment (citing a prior agreement) and promises Lady Shar’s warriors and her followers will back you if you comply; she threatens violence if you refuse. Off-screen companion mechanics and events (for example the circus dryad’s “Test your love”) can explain why Shadowheart is away and not available to be handed over immediately.
- LOW_HouseOfGrief_MeetingViconia_OM_Shadowheart_COM.json: Shadowheart meets with Viconia who is still hooded. However Viconia soon reveals who she is and invites Shadowheart to speak down below in the Grotto.
- LOW_HouseOfGrief_MeetingViconia_OM_Shadowheart_AOM_OOM.json: Shadowheart meets with Viconia who is still hooded. However Viconia soon reveals who she is and invites Shadowheart to speak down below in the Grotto.
- LOW_SharGrotto_ConfrontViconia_OM_Shadowheart_AOM_OOM.json: Shadowheart confronts Viconia about her past and potentially the leadership of the cult itself. Alternatively, she may just seek to fight her former mistress in order to free her parents, should she know they're alive.
- LOW_SharGrotto_ViconiaDefeated_OM_Shadowheart_COM.json: Shadowheart deals with Viconia after she has been defeated. Shadowheart could have come here to lead a coup against Viconia and seize control of the Shar Grotto, or she could have turned from her faith and have come here to rescue her captive parents.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Viconia DeVir: You and I need to speak... (node 35)

Sample 2:
- Viconia DeVir: Remember our agreement - deliver Shadowheart to me, and you can count upon Lady Shar's warriors at your side, when the time comes. (node 40)

context: You approached Viconia in the Shar Grotto while Shadowheart—the companion who once guarded the Astral Prism—is not present. Viconia still insists the Astral Prism be returned, but the artefact is now impossible to recover, so she invokes a prior agreement and demands you hand Shadowheart over for punishment instead. Off-screen companion mechanics or other off-screen events (for example the circus dryad’s “Test Your Love”) can explain why Shadowheart is away and cannot be produced immediately. Viconia warns that Lady Shar’s warriors and her followers will support you if you comply and threatens violence from her cult if you refuse.
